mapper.insert: insert into essay (user_id, title, level, author_type, status, publish_time, journal_name, certificate_path, certificate_name, certificate_size) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{level}, #{authorType}, #{status}, #{publishTime}, #{journalName}, #{certificatePath}, #{certificateName}, #{certificateSize})
mapper.select: select e.id, e.user_id userId, e.title, e.level, e.author_type authorType, e.status, e.publish_time publishTime, e.journal_name journalName, e.certificate_path certificatePath, e.certificate_name certificateName, e.certificate_size certificateSize, e.audit_user_id auditUserId, e.audit_time auditTime, e.audit_remark auditRemark, e.create_time createTime, e.update_time updateTime, e.delete_flag deleteFlag, u.real_name userName, u.employee_id employeeId, u.phone phone, u.department department, u.email email from essay e left join users u on e.user_id = u.id where e.delete_flag = 0 AND e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.status = #{status} order by e.create_time desc
